To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the integration of machine and human intelligence can improve the accuracy of BGP anomaly detection, and that the visualization techniques used by the program can help network operators to understand better the behavior of BGP.

the integration of human intelligence and machine intelligence can effectively improve anomaly detection performance and that the visual-based approach is effective in identifying and correlating previously unknown BGP OASC events.
the integration of visual-based analysis, machine intelligence, and human interaction can effectively improve the detection and correlation of BGP OASC events.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing and evaluating a visual-based BGP anomaly detection system, which can be used to detect and correlate BGP routing anomalies and security attacks, such as BGP prefix hijacking.

developing an anomaly detection system that can provide a high-level view of BGP routing dynamics and help network operators to identify, correlate, and analyze previously unknown security problems and routing anomalies.
the development of an interactive system that can help network operators to analyze, detect and correlate BGP OASC events in real-time.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed visual-based anomaly detection program is an effective and efficient tool for BGP OASC anomaly detection and correlation, and it can provide network operators with an accurate, comprehensive, and easy to understand high-level abstraction about BGP routing dynamics.
the program is a promising tool to assist network administrators in detecting and diagnosing anomalies in BGP routing.

the integration of machine intelligence and human intelligence can significantly improve the performance of BGP/OASC anomaly detection, and can provide a better and more effective way to correlate alerts.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are able to detect, identify and correlate OASC events, which are not only rare but also hard to find, by integrating machine and human intelligence.
the integration of machine intelligence and human intelligence can be a powerful tool to improve the performance of security event analysis.

, in addition to the existing machine learning techniques, we have developed a visual-based anomaly detection approach that is capable of identifying BGP routing anomalies and security attacks, as well as correlating previously unknown BGP routing anomalies.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, by combining the power of machine intelligence with the ability of human intelligence in visualizing and interpreting information, one can achieve a much higher degree of anomaly detection, alert correlation, and network security.
the integration of machine intelligence and visual-based human interaction can effectively improve anomaly detection, alert correlation, and network monitoring.

, while the current practice of anomaly detection and correlation is based on the use of a variety of complex and sophisticated machine learning techniques, the human-interactive visual approach can provide complementary information to the existing techniques and, in some cases, can even outperform them in the analysis of real-life network events.
